body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature that can see you. Until your next turn, the first Action it uses against you burns 1 die.

surges.html: Gain +1 Defense against the next Reaction triggered by this Action.
Until the end of this turn, you may pass through spaces one size category smaller than normal.

rider.title: MIMIC ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Borrowed Pattern. While maintained: You may visually match nearby terrain or a creature of similar size; the first Action against you each round cannot benefit from targeting bonuses.
